title: Pika H3 Flex: Reference to Video
summary: Generate a video with synchronized audio from reference images with Pika H3 Flex, keeping the identity, costume and look of the references while the prompt carries the story. Two image inputs are wired as Picture 1 and Picture 2, and the Pika adapter runs at strength 1.0 with the lcm sampler and a six-step sigma list on the MiniMax H3 Ref2VA base. Ideal for character-consistent short clips with native sound.
